text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein enjoys good health, arrives in London on work visit.
- In words addressed to Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu during a meeting at last week's Washington summit, King Hussein says we "are at the brink... and on the verge of falling together."
- Prime Minister Kabariti says king is the "conscience of the nation and peace is a strategic option with no return."
- A strong tremor shakes the Eastern Mediterranean, no damages in Jordan.
- Israeli concern over the political crisis with Jordan, and Jordanian ambassador in Tel Aviv denies arranging any visit of Israeli officials to Jordan.
- Netanyahu seeks to address crisis with Jordan, king said to have told Israeli premier to "drop arrogance of power".
- Crown Prince says Jordan accomplished major part of economic reforms, deserves help.
- Kabariti briefs Senate on latest events and Jordanian role in the Washington summit.
- King arrives in London and pays for sick little girl's operation.
- Crown Prince Hassan says "our firm stance over Jerusalem has proved that normalisation (with Israel) does not mean relinquishing our rights."
- King undergoes routine medical checkups in U.S. Mayo clinic.
- Regent say "good management is what makes Jordan an economic hub..and signing of the partnership accord with the EU confronts us with open challenges."
